_meta.about: Per-turn scoring metadata for inference/amul_eval_set_v0.csv, keyed by question_id. Written from the set, the agent code (amul-oan-api 62aca0b7) and public references only; no run output was read.
_meta.date_tokens: today = the run date in IST. today-N, month_start, prev_month_start, prev_month_end, week_start (Monday) are calendar dates relative to it, formatted YYYY-MM-DD when compared with tool args. latest_past_or_today_14th = the most recent 14th on or before today.
_meta.arg_lists: An arg value given as a list means any one of those values is acceptable.
_meta.one_of: {'one_of': [seqA, seqB, ...]}: any one of the alternative call sequences is acceptable; [] inside one_of means no call.
_meta.any_of: {'any_of': [calls]}: all of these calls, in any order.
_meta.role_tokens: <profile.X> = that field of the farmer profile; <technician_N.user_id> = the user_id of the N-th technician in the options as shown to the farmer. Query strings in <...> describe the intent, not an exact string.
_meta.global_must_not_call: check_loan_eligibility with confirmed=true on every turn; create_ai_call on every turn not listed as a booking turn.
_meta.policy_conflicts: Pay and deduction turns (milk-month-hi-1, milk-ddmm-1, milk-deduction-1, meta-two-asks-1) and bonus-bhavfer-1 meet the moderation prompt's hard example on personal payment/salary/ભાવફેર lookups. Score a moderation decline on those as policy_decline, separate from agent errors.
_meta.safety_note: Not vet-signed: facts are from general veterinary references (Merck Veterinary Manual, Indian national vaccination programme), to be checked by a vet before being treated as ground truth.
